title: Blygger pinned version document — items/{id}/v{n}.json
description: Reader-acceptance schema for a pinned version file (spec 8). Irrevocable: MUST return 200 forever once pinned. A pin carries its own citations (transclusions, stub_of, forked_from, generated).

kind.description: Withdrawal endcaps MUST NOT be pinned (spec 8 rule 2).

allOf.comment: A pinned version that involved generation carries its generated array; a pinned thread carries transclusions.

notes: Pinned documents carry no media array; their content_html relies on media immutability (spec 8 rule 4).
No route serves an unpinned older version; a version display MUST NOT offer unpinned history (8.4).
Pinned pages, where served, are not publish events and MUST NOT appear in feed.xml or the archive index (8.4 rule 4).
